scientific_integrity: The original quartic ovals, chemical vector field, existence construction, and local stability criterion are credited to their prior authors; the new claim concerns a different explicitly specified completion preserving on-oval clocks and spectra. Proof and reproducibility script are provided. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The completed field has an exact positive-quadrant phase portrait, not a global classification of the originating unmodified chemical flow. A finite mass-action realization is asserted without weak reversibility, reaction-minimality or generic robustness. Computational tests at three finite integer cases corroborate but cannot prove the all-integer theorem. An unindexed general Lyapunov-completion theorem may affect novelty priority.
title: A degree-preserving kinetic completion with exact nested-oval basins and Floquet data
